aggregation.timing_and_memory: Median [min, max] over 3 seeds x 3 repeats = 9 workers per cell.
aggregation.quality: Median [min, max] over 3 seeds, using repeat 1 after exact repeat metric/hash checks.
aggregation.total_seconds: fit_seconds + first transform_seconds; additional transforms are excluded.
aggregation.repeated_transform: Median of 2 additional transform calls per worker, then median [min, max] across 9 workers.
aggregation.speedup: Median [min, max] of 9 matched numerator_seconds / denominator_seconds ratios; not ratio of medians.
aggregation.matching: Same archived run, training policy, train/query sizes, features, neighbors, metric/weights configuration, target training missingness, query pattern, dtype, threads, repeated-transform count, seed, repeat, and input fingerprints.
aggregation.duration_change: Median [min, max] of 100 * (denominator_seconds / numerator_seconds - 1) over matched workers.
aggregation.quality_evidence: Aggregated archived worker RMSE/MAE and scored-cell differences. Prediction/truth arrays are not included in this ZIP.
aggregation.numeric_precision: No rounding before JSON serialization. Values are Python binary64 calculations from parsed JSON numbers, serialized with round-trip precision.
